Starting today, Runna subscription users can use the new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna 加入應對高溫嘅訓練工具

Personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, aiming to support users throughout their entire training cycle — from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The new "Adapt for Heat" feature, launching today, will help users find cooler running windows and suggest adjusted pace targets based on perceived temperature, training duration, and the specific session.

"Adapt for Heat" will display a color-coded hourly weather forecast, allowing users to quickly identify the best times to run and plan their training accordingly.

Here's Runna's introduction to this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature — once a user starts a race plan ranging from 5km to 50km, the system will automatically generate a corresponding recovery plan. Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce wear and tear and injury risk."

Lastly, the platform also revealed that a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans and automatically transition from one to the next after completing a plan, making long-term training scheduling more seamless.

Here's Runna's introduction to the benefits of "Upcoming Plans":

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack multiple races, phase goals, and training blocks, giving them full visibility over the year ahead. No resetting between plans: no need to rebuild or start over — your usual training schedule, predicted finish times, and current fitness level carry over automatically when one plan ends and the next begins. Flexible and entirely on your terms: every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, so runners stay fully in control of their training experience. Built for progress: every plan is designed by Runna's expert coaches using proven training principles, supporting sustainable progression, recovery, and race-day readiness.
